The '''Holwuff''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alliga]], controlling powerful corporate interests.

They were represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] by [[Rogwa Wodrata/Legends|Rogwa Wodrata]], and later joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] when Wodrata defected prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].

==Biology and appearance==
A Holwuff's upper appendages were very similar in appearance to those of the [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthians]]. They were large, furry aliens, and their eyes were black. Two small tusks protruded from the upper jaw.

==History==
Once members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Holwuffs were represented by Senator Rogwa Wodrata in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], they seceded from the Republic and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
